rationale: A recovery policy needs a durable per-trial bound on provider-side physical executions. It prevents unbounded retry work while remaining distinct from max_controller_attempts, which bounds physical controller Job attempts.
alternatives: Remove and rely on controller attempt limits, but that would not bound repeated trial executions within a controller attempt.
Rename to max_execution_attempts_per_trial, but dropping physical loses the necessary distinction between one logical trial and its concrete executions.
simplestChoice: Keep the existing field and name.
